gloss: to kick away; to kick hard; to reject

definitions.gloss: to kick away; to kick hard
definitions.explanation: To kick something or someone forcefully.

definitions.gloss: to reject; to turn down flatly
definitions.explanation: To refuse an offer or proposal dismissively.

examples.japanese: {邪魔|じゃま}な{石|いし}を{蹴飛|けと}ばした。
examples.english: I kicked away the stone that was in the way.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{高額|こうがく}のオファーを{蹴飛|けと}ばした。
examples.english: He turned down the generous offer.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{缶|かん}を{蹴飛|けと}ばして{歩|ある}く。
examples.english: To walk while kicking an empty can.

examples.japanese: {布団|ふとん}を{蹴飛|けと}ばして{寝|ね}ている。
examples.english: He's sleeping with the blanket kicked off.

examples.japanese: せっかくの{昇進|しょうしん}のチャンスを{蹴飛|けと}ばした。
examples.english: She turned down a rare chance for promotion.

examples.japanese: {条件|じょうけん}が{気|き}に{入|い}らなくて、{契約|けいやく}を{蹴飛|けと}ばした。
examples.english: I didn't like the terms, so I rejected the contract.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{蹴飛|けと}ばす → {蹴飛|けと}ばさない (negative)
・{蹴飛|けと}ばす → {蹴飛|けと}ばして (te-form)
・{蹴飛|けと}ばす → {蹴飛|けと}ばした (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {蹴|け}る (to kick) + {飛|と}ばす (to make fly)

USAGE:
・{申|もう}し{出|で}を{蹴飛|けと}ばす (to reject an offer)
・{提案|ていあん}を{蹴飛|けと}ばす (to reject a proposal)
・{布団|ふとん}を{蹴飛|けと}ばす (to kick off the blanket)

NUANCE:
Stronger than simple {蹴|け}る. Implies force or dismissiveness.
